clue.text: How one might describe daughter exciting males?

definitions.text: How one might describe daughter exciting males?

parts.note: D is the standard abbreviation for daughter, as in family trees

indicators.note: exciting means stirring up, so the letters of the following word are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl whose looks set the men's hearts racing might be called this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exciting' makes AMSEL; read whole, the clue also pictures a girl who might set men's pulses racing.
explanation.definitionFit: A damsel is an old-fashioned word for a young unmarried woman, which a daughter may be.

clue.text: Welcome a learner around cricket club with purpose

indicators.note: around tells us the first pair of letters wraps itself about the club's abbreviation

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate letter
purpose means aim or intention

explanation.surface: A novice is greeted warmly at the cricket club for a reason.
explanation.definitionFit: To acclaim someone is to greet or hail them with enthusiastic approval, a warm welcome.

clue.text: Catchers of fish brought up to avoid river disagreement

indicators.note: to avoid says the letter for river must be left out
in a down clue, brought up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: otters are animals that catch fish

explanation.surface: Anglers fishing upstream keep away from the river after an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns OTTERS into SRETTO; 'to avoid river' removes its R.
explanation.definitionFit: A set-to is a brief but heated quarrel or fight, a disagreement.

clue.text: Mind careless talk of hero overlooking hotel

indicators.note: careless suggests sloppy, jumbled speech, so the letters of the phrase are mixed up
overlooking means passing over, so one letter is left out of the jumble

parts.note: H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Beware of the hero's loose gossip about a hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'careless' jumbles TALK OF HERO, and 'overlooking hotel' says the H is dropped, leaving the nine letters of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To mind children or a house is to take care of them, a common phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Distant commander with a touch of levity? That's ridiculous

parts.note: distant means far away
CIC is short for commander-in-chief

indicators.note: a touch of means only a small part, the first letter, of the next word is used

explanation.surface: A remote military leader with a light sense of humour seems absurd.
explanation.definitionFit: Something farcical is so absurd as to be laughable, like a farce, hence ridiculous.

clue.text: Supporter with, we hear, reasonable display of enthusiasm

parts.note: a fan is a supporter of a team or performer

indicators.note: we hear says the next word is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: fair means reasonable or just

explanation.surface: A fan shows a sensible amount of excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: A fanfare is a showy flourish of trumpets, and by extension any loud display of enthusiasm.

clue.text: Wine and port a judge knocked back

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

indicators.note: knocked back means turned backwards, so the pair is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A judge downs a glass of wine and port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' turns A J into JA after RIO; it also suggests drinking, which fits the wine surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Rioja is a red or white Spanish wine from the La Rioja region.

clue.text: It comes first in time shown by railway journey plan

parts.note: an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Something takes priority in a schedule set by the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: An itinerary is the planned route of a journey, a travel plan.

clue.text: Mean woman in maturity

indicators.note: in says the woman's name goes inside the word for maturity

parts.note: age can mean maturity, as in 'come of age'
Vera is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A grown-up woman is described as unkind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' reads as unkind, but it is the arithmetic sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean is the arithmetic average of a set of numbers.

clue.text: Reduce in importance a neat duvet filler's principle?

definitions.meaning: to humble someone or reduce their self-importance
read literally: the down stuffing a duvet should be trimmed to fit it

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the phrase literally as feather down cut to fit the cover.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut someone down to size is to deflate their pride and make them less important.

clue.text: Old man taking in a number with sheep in wide survey

indicators.note: taking in means holding inside, so the father's letters surround the rest

parts.note: old man is slang for father, PA
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: Father counts the sheep across a broad view of the farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old man' is the usual crossword shorthand for a father.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is an unbroken view of a wide area, or a comprehensive survey of a subject.

clue.text: A vote celebrity reversed for one making cuts

parts.note: X is the mark placed on a ballot paper as a vote

indicators.note: reversed says the word for celebrity is written backwards

parts.note: a big name is a celebrity

explanation.surface: A famous person's ballot was overturned by someone slashing budgets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' gives EMAN; 'one making cuts' hints at a cost-cutter as well as a woodsman.
explanation.definitionFit: An axeman wields an axe, so he makes cuts; also used of a ruthless cost-cutter.

clue.text: Mean French product in the UK?

definitions.meaning: as a noun, the meaning or significance of something
goods from France sold in Britain are brought in from abroad

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is the noun for meaning, as in 'a matter of great import'.
explanation.definitionFit: Import means significance, and an import is also goods brought into a country from abroad.

clue.text: Old conservationists, muscular types with director, showing an improvement?

parts.note: the NT, the National Trust, is a British conservation charity for historic buildings and land
he-men are muscular macho types

explanation.surface: Elderly preservationists, bodybuilders and a film director look better.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on the mend is recovering, getting better after illness.

clue.text: Cadet due to get new order instructed

indicators.note: a new order for letters means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trainee officer is going to receive fresh instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get new order' rearranges CADET DUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Educated means taught or schooled, which is to have been instructed.

clue.text: Peacekeepers beginning to concentrate on church service? There's indifference

parts.note: UN peacekeepers serve under the United Nations

indicators.note: beginning to means the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the RN, the Royal Navy, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: UN troops start to focus on a church service, though nobody cares.
explanation.definitionFit: Unconcern is a lack of worry or interest, an indifferent attitude.

clue.text: Station familiar to Aussies?

definitions.meaning: a state in south-east Australia, well known to its people

explanation.walkthrough: Victoria is a London railway station and also an Australian state.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria names both a London rail terminus and the Australian state whose capital is Melbourne.

clue.text: Probe elected part of church reportedly

parts.note: a candidate who is elected is in

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is replaced by another that sounds the same

parts.note: the choir is the part of a church where the singers sit

explanation.surface: An investigation into a newly voted section of the church, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: To inquire is to ask questions or investigate, to probe into something.

clue.text: Dislike source of rocking in galley at sea

indicators.note: in places the opening letter inside the jumbled ship word
at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are rearranged
source of means the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Sailors hate the motion of the boat's kitchen in rough seas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' rearranges GALLEY to ALLEGY, and 'in' puts R (from 'source of rocking') inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An allergy is a reaction against something, and figuratively a strong dislike or aversion.

clue.text: Bashful note about old wolfish type

indicators.note: about means around, so the other letters surround the letter for old

parts.note: coy means shy or bashful
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A shy musical note concerning an elderly predator.
explanation.definitionFit: A coyote is a North American wild dog, a prairie wolf.

clue.text: Pair almost

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held is 'Pair almost (7)', cut short: the blog's parse needs a further word meaning become confused (ADDLE) after TW(o), and no search gave the full clue.

clue.text: Sing in picturesque alleyway

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of letters across the words that follow

explanation.surface: Perform a song in a pretty little lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sing' is slang for informing on someone, not making music.
explanation.definitionFit: To squeal and to sing are both slang for informing to the police.

clue.text: Flower raised in row with no end of care

indicators.note: in places the word for raised inside the shortened row
with no says a letter is dropped from the word for row

parts.note: a line is a row

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word that follows

parts.note: raised means up

explanation.surface: A bloom grows up in a line that nobody tends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of care' drops the final E, leaving LIN, which 'in' wraps round the word for raised.
explanation.definitionFit: The lupin is a garden flower with tall spikes of pea-like blooms.

clue.text: Secure form of transport around centre of Paris for a crawler?

parts.note: to land something is to secure it, as a deal

indicators.note: around means the vehicle's letters surround the middle letter

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

indicators.note: centre of means the middle letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Get a taxi round the middle of Paris for a slow-moving creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts R, the centre of PARIS, inside CAB.
explanation.definitionFit: A land crab is a crab living mostly on land, and crabs crawl sideways.

clue.text: Couple of firms associated with a drink

indicators.note: couple of means two of what follows, so the abbreviation appears twice

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: Two businesses join forces over a hot beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa is a hot drink made from powdered cacao beans.

clue.text: Green divorcee consumed by exotic recipe in end

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed by, so the former spouse sits inside the jumble
exotic means strange or foreign, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse, a divorcee

explanation.surface: A former spouse swallowed by a foreign dish at the end looks naive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' gives INPERIENCED, opened by 'consumed by'; 'Green' means naive here, not the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Green means young and untried, lacking experience.

clue.text: Aim held by figure leading outsiders from crazy political faction

indicators.note: leading means coming in front of what follows
held by means contained inside, so the word for aim goes inside the number

parts.note: ten is a figure, a number
an end is an aim or goal

indicators.note: outsiders from means the first and last letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A target shared by a group heading the fringes of a mad political splinter group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held by' gives TENDEN, which 'leading' puts in front; Militant Tendency was a British left-wing faction.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendency is a faction within a political party, as in Militant Tendency.

clue.text: Tidy part of scene at engagement

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Tidying up part of the venue for a betrothal party.
explanation.definitionFit: To neaten something is to make it tidier, so the two verbs are synonyms.
